sloka: पूर्णे चतुर्दशे वर्षे पञ्चम्यां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।भरद्वाजश्रमं प्राप्य ववन्दे नियतो मुनिम् ।। ६.१२७.१ ।।
transliteration: pūrṇe caturdaśe varṣe pañcamyāṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।bharadvājaśramaṁ prāpya vavande niyato munim ।। 6.127.1 ।।

translations.english: After the fourteenth year of exile, on the fifth day of the bright half of lunar month Sri Rama and Lakshmana reached Bharadwaja's hermitage. They bent their heads down (as a mark of respect) and offered salutations.
